headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to improve how they handle permits and reviews for infrastructure projects.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Obama, aims to make federal permitting and review of infrastructure projects work better. Infrastructure projects can include things like roads, bridges, pipelines, and power lines. No summary was provided, so the specific steps the order requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that issue permits or review infrastructure projects
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to change how they carry out permitting and review work.

who_it_affects.group: Companies and public bodies that build infrastructure projects
who_it_affects.how: The federal permits and reviews they must go through may be handled differently.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 22, 2012; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
